catalogue_requests.reason: no catalogue class stops the acquisition of a spectrum analyser: the stop classes cover motion and actuation, and this instrument has no actuator to stop. The action takes no input, sets the upstream continuous property (INIT:CONTinuous OFF, src/labtoolkit/SpectrumAnalyser/AgilentE44nn.py:242-248) and reports the resulting state; it is the declared safe-state action (safe_state=True) of this hardware R1 package.

notes:
The gate passed on the fake backend with no finding and no warning (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The card's decision is direct-driver, which this package follows: one decorated Driver over labtoolkit.SpectrumAnalyser.AgilentE44nn:AgilentE44nn, the card's first entry symbol, with a native.py factory that opens the VISA resource and passes it to the class. Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached, native.py was never imported and no analyser was opened, swept or measured.

NOT COVERED: the trace array, the analyser's binary TRAC:DATA? TRACE1 sweep (FORM:DATA REAL,32, src/labtoolkit/SpectrumAnalyser/AgilentE44nn.py:289-300; the README returns it as a DataFrame, README.md:53-54). That array is the measurement of a spectrum analyser, but the receipt of this package carries scalars only, so the driver exposes the sweep settings and no measurement value; it never returns the array. A reviewer who judges the trace essential for this device should treat the package as NEEDS_ARTIFACTS rather than accept a settings-only driver. Also not exposed: the amplitude settings (reference level, input attenuation, unit_power, detector, trace type) and screenshot(), because the clone states no range for them and this standard has no unit atom for dBm or dB; and frequency_start/frequency_stop, which are the same sweep window as frequency_center/frequency_span.

BOUNDS. One sourced limit: sweep_points, 101 to 8192 points, from the class's own comment for the E4440A (src/labtoolkit/SpectrumAnalyser/AgilentE44nn.py:101-102; the comment also allows 2 to 8192 in zero span, so a zero-span sweep of 2 to 100 points is refused as well, which narrows and never widens). Four operator_required fields: frequency_center, frequency_span, resolution_bandwidth and video_bandwidth. No line of the clone states a frequency or bandwidth range of the E44nn family: the registry maps six PSA models with top frequencies from 6.7 GHz to 50 GHz (src/labtoolkit/drivers.py:94-99) and the class does not report which model is attached; the bandwidth comments name the N9030B, another model. Every call that sets one of the four is refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the operator's site-limits.json supplies the range of the unit; site-limits.example.json is an example overlay, not a statement about any analyser.

SAFETY. The analyser is R1 and has no actuator outside its own settings; the native stop is the continuous sweep switched off (INIT:CONTinuous OFF), called by @estop and by the safe-state action x-cap.davidlutton.stop_sweep.v1. estop_physical_ref is not set because no line of the clone documents an independent hardware stop, and SAFE-045 applies at R2 and above only. The hardware backend (native.py, the VISA resource) was never run; this package is model-authored, reviewed_by stays null, and its risk is R1, so the loader of this SDK does not hold back its hardware backend the way it does at R2 and R3 -- enabling it stays an operator decision without any review protection from this package.

FAKE. fake.py is an in-memory stand-in whose starting values are test data, each marked # placeholder: a real analyser reports the model, serial and firmware it has and its own current sweep settings, and a real sweep has the number of points the sweep_points setting asks for (up to 8192), while the fake only holds the six scalar settings this package reads and writes. It is not a recording of the device. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
